auth.registration.title: Fungura konti yawe

Ba umwe mu bakoresha AWA utangire
ingendo yawe utuje.

auth.forgotPassword.title: Wibagiwe ijambo ry'ibanga?
auth.forgotPassword.subtitle:
Nta kibazo. Andika imeri yawe
tukohereze umurongo wo kurisubizaho.
auth.forgotPassword.cardText: Turakohereza amabwiriza ukeneye yo gusubizaho ijambo ry'ibanga.
auth.forgotPassword.infoValidEmail: Imeri ni nyayo. Kohereza umurongo wo gusubizaho bizashoboka igihe serivisi yo kwinjira izaba ikora.
auth.forgotPassword.helpText: Vugana n'itsinda ryacu ry'ubufasha, turi hano kugufasha.
auth.forgotPassword.helpAlertMessage: Itsinda ryacu ry'ubufasha rizagusubiza vuba bishoboka.
anonymous.mode.activeSubtitle: Profili yawe iguma itandukanye n'umwirondoro wawe igihe ubu buryo bukora.
anonymous.mode.nothingKeptSubtitle: Aya makuru ntahuzwa na profili yawe itazwi.
anonymous.mode.appLockText: Kode ya PIN cyangwa ikimenyetso cy'umubiri iyo ufunguye AWA
anonymous.mode.disableText: Kugira ngo uve mu buryo butazwi, ushobora gufungura konti ukayihuza n'imeri cyangwa indangamuntu.
anonymous.mode.pitchSubtitle: Koresha umwanya wawe muri AWA utahuje umwirondoro wawe na profili yawe.
anonymous.mode.identityPrivateSubtitle: Amakuru yagufata ntasabwa kugira ngo ukoreshe ubu buryo.
anonymous.mode.privacyRowAccount: Nta konti ya Google cyangwa Apple ihujwe
anonymous.mode.infoText: Zimwe mu ngingo za konti, guhuza amakuru cyangwa kugarura konti zishobora kugarukira mu buryo butazwi.
anonymous.mode.recommendedProtectionText: Uzashobora kurinda kwinjira muri AWA ukoresheje kode ya PIN cyangwa ikimenyetso cy'umubiri.
anonymous.limitations.title: Mbere yo gukomeza
anonymous.limitations.subtitle: Mu buryo butazwi, zimwe mu ngingo zijyanye na konti zizagarukira cyangwa ntizibeho.
anonymous.limitations.recoveryText: Nta meri ihujwe, kugarura uburenganzira kuri konti yawe bishobora kugarukira.
anonymous.limitations.syncText: Amakuru amwe ashobora kutagaragara ku zindi telefoni zawe.
anonymous.limitations.communicationsText: AWA ntizashobora kukwoherereza imeri zijyanye na konti yawe itazwi.
anonymous.limitations.securityText: Tugusaba gufungura kode ya PIN cyangwa ikimenyetso cy'umubiri kugira ngo urinde kwinjira muri AWA.
anonymous.creating.creatingSubtitle: AWA irimo gutegura umwanya wawe bwite no gutandukanya profili yawe n'amakuru agaragaza umwirondoro wawe.
anonymous.creating.errorSubtitle: Hari ikitagenze neza. Ushobora kongera kugerageza.
anonymous.creating.protectionSubtitle: AWA irimo gutegura umwanya wawe ishyiraho ibyo wahisemo ku ibanga.
anonymous.creating.warning: Ntufunge porogaramu mu gihe umwanya wawe uri gutegurwa.
anonymous.success.title: Uburyo butazwi burafunguye
anonymous.success.subtitle: Profili yawe ubu itandukanye n'umwirondoro wawe. Koresha AWA mu ibanga ryuzuye.
anonymous.success.cardSubtitle: Ushobora kuzimya uburyo butazwi igihe cyose uhereye mu Ibanga n'umutekano.
anonymous.avatar.title: Kora avatar igusa
anonymous.avatar.subtitle: Hitamo gusa imiterere n'ibara. Nta ifoto yawe bwite ikenewe.
anonymous.avatar.styleSectionDescription: Ushobora kuyihindura nyuma muri profili yawe.
anonymous.avatar.infoText: Iyi avatar isimbura ifoto yawe igihe uburyo butazwi bukora. Nta ifoto nyayo ikoreshwa kuri profili yawe.
anonymous.avatarStyles.headscarfGlasses: Avatar ifite igitambaro ku mutwe n'amadarubindi

privacySecurity.biometrySubtitleOn: Kanda kugira ngo ugerageze cyangwa uzimye

Igenamiterere ry'ibanga ryawe rikomeza kuba mu maboko yawe.

discreetLauncher.title: Isura y'ibanga
discreetLauncher.subtitle: Hitamo uko AWA igaragara ku rupapuro rwawe rwa mbere
discreetLauncher.infoCard: Ibi bihindura gusa izina n'ikimenyetso bya porogaramu ku rupapuro rwawe rwa mbere. Amakuru yawe n'uburinzi bwayo (kode ya PIN, ikimenyetso cy'umubiri, ibanga ry'amakuru) biguma uko biri, uko waba uhisemo kose.
discreetLauncher.androidOnly: Iyi ngingo iboneka kuri Android gusa.
discreetLauncher.discreetDescription: Igaragara nka porogaramu isanzwe ya agenda, nta kivuga kuri AWA
discreetLauncher.unsupportedVendor: Iyi ngingo igarukira ku rupapuro rwa mbere rwa telefoni yawe.
discreetLauncher.noteDelay: Ikimenyetso gishya gishobora gufata amasegonda make kugira ngo kigaragare bitewe n'urupapuro rwa mbere rwa Android yawe.
discreetLauncher.switchDiscreetBody: Porogaramu izagaragara ku izina “Agenda” ifite ikimenyetso gisanzwe ku rupapuro rwawe rwa mbere. Amakuru n'igenamiterere byawe bizaguma uko biri.
discreetLauncher.switchAwaBody: Porogaramu izongera kugaragara ku izina n'ikimenyetso bya AWA.
discreetLauncher.errorModalBody: Ntibishoboka guhindura isura ya porogaramu ubu. Isura yawe y'ubu ntiyahindutse. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
discreetLauncher.unsupportedVendorModalB: Guhindura ikimenyetso ntibishyigikiwe kuri iyi telefoni. Iyi ngingo igarukira ku rupapuro rwa mbere rwa telefoni yawe. Isura yawe y'ubu ntiyahindutse.

securitySetup.biometricsDescription: Koresha igikumwe cyangwa isura byo kuri telefoni yawe.
securitySetup.discreetNotificationsDescr: Hisha ibisobanuro byihariye mu bigaragara by'imenyesha ryawe.

privacyScreen.title:
Ibanga ryawe
ni cyo kintu cya mbere

Ugumana ububasha bwuzuye ku makuru yawe.
Tuyarinda kuri buri ntambwe.
privacyScreen.guarantees.noResaleDescrip: Amakuru yawe ntagurishwa, ntahabwa abandi, kandi ntakoreshwa mu bucuruzi.
privacyScreen.guarantees.fullControlDesc: Ugumana ububasha ku makuru yawe n'uko akoreshwa, igihe cyose.
privacyScreen.guarantees.noExportDescrip: Amakuru yawe bwite ntasohorwa hanze ya serivisi.
privacyScreen.guarantees.encryptedDescri: Amakuru yihariye arakingiwe kandi amakuru y'umwirondoro ntagaragaza uwo ari we.
privacyScreen.commitmentFullControl: Ugumana ububasha ku makuru yawe igihe cyose.
privacyScreen.commitmentNoExport: Nta na rimwe mu makuru yawe bwite risohorwa.
privacyScreen.commitmentNoInternalAccess: Nta kwinjira imbere mu mikorere byemewe uretse mu bikorwa bikenewe cyane kandi byizewe.
privacyScreen.commitmentIdentityEncrypte: Amakuru y'umwirondoro, nk'izina ryawe, arafunze kandi ntagaragaza uwo ari we.
privacyScreen.freedomText: Ushobora guhindura ibyo ukunda cyangwa gusaba isiba ry'amakuru yawe igihe cyose mu Igenamiterere.
